text.en:
The name of Sto. Tomas Elementary School in the Municipality of Passi, Province of Iloilo, is
hereby changed to Fidelidad J. Santibanez Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 14, 1982
